strings.title: A Window onto the Crime
strings.hint: A witness may identify the person correctly but name the wrong room. Compare patch and radiator, then check whose presence covers the entire interval.
strings.solvedText: Rana Salem is the killer. The 20:08 photograph places her in map room M: its horizontal radiator and upper brass patch match maintenance records, while the sightline excludes Z. The 20:03–20:04 clip covers nothing later; Younes was alive until 20:06:30. Rana adopted Maha’s room error despite denying entry. The others have continuous coverage, and the undisclosed-interest records support motive. No invented exact minute of death is needed.
strings.summary.text: Engineer Younes Murad was killed in Al-Saray Library’s map room. A reliable witness knows one suspect and places her in the visitors’ salon. The photograph is authentic and the identity correct—but is the room identification correct too? This investigation concerns location and continuity of presence, with no clock offsets or trick mirrors.
strings.summary.victim.name: Younes Murad
strings.summary.victim.note: Reviewing a recommendation to restore the library rather than demolish it.
strings.scene.address: Al-Saray Library — map room and visitors’ salon
strings.scene.intro: The map room, M, lies north along the façade; the visitors’ salon, Z, lies south. A projecting stone buttress separates their windows. Walking between the rooms indoors takes less than 30 seconds.
strings.scene.notes[0]: The library was closed to the public and everyone present is accounted for.
strings.scene.notes[1]: Clocks agree and images are not mirrored.
strings.scene.notes[2]: Check witnesses’ room names against physical landmarks.
strings.evidence[0].title: Original kiosk photograph
strings.evidence[0].desc: 20:08: Rana’s face is clear. Below the window is a horizontal radiator; a square brass patch occupies an upper corner, with part of the buttress at the edge. This is a direct view, not a reflection. Identity is separate from the witness’s room label.
strings.evidence[1].title: The short salon clip
strings.evidence[1].desc: 20:03–20:04: Rana and Hadi are in the salon. Its window has no radiator and a dark wooden patch in a lower corner. The end of a video is not evidence of continuing presence.
strings.evidence[2].title: Receipt for a new transaction
strings.evidence[2].desc: Transaction created at 20:05; Younes signed and discussed it with Yahya at 20:06. Yahya left at 20:06:30. This was live interaction involving new information, not an earlier recording.
strings.evidence[3].title: Window repair register
strings.evidence[3].desc: 10 June: room M — upper brass patch and retained horizontal radiator. Room Z — lower wooden patch; radiator removed in February. Original maintenance photographs confirm these features, unchanged on the night.
strings.evidence[4].title: The older boot mark
strings.evidence[4].desc: Mud from Omar’s boot is consistent with a map-room mark, but an original 17:15 floor photograph already shows it. Its presence alone cannot date it to the killing.
strings.evidence[5].title: Recovered decision sheet
strings.evidence[5].desc: Recovered from waste: restore rather than demolish, suspend the land deal pending Rana Salem’s conflict-of-interest disclosure. Younes’s signature is authentic. No usable print identifies who discarded it.
strings.evidence[6].title: Undisclosed ownership
strings.evidence[6].desc: Authenticated records link Rana to the purchaser. She requested removal of the conflict clause; Younes refused. Omar also had a separate financial interest. Motive alone does not identify the killer.
strings.evidence[7].title: Continuous presence records
strings.evidence[7].desc: Omar: service yard 20:02–20:11, supplier and footage. Salma: copy room 20:04–20:10 with Noha. Hadi: maintenance hall, back before 20:05 and filming until 20:12. Each has continuous interaction during the critical interval.
strings.suspects[0].name: Rana Salem
strings.suspects[0].relation: Undisclosed ownership interest in the land purchaser.
strings.suspects[0].alibi: Says she stayed in the salon from 20:03 until the meeting resumed.
strings.suspects[0].statement: Hadi’s video establishes my location, and Maha saw me from her kiosk at 20:08. I did not enter the map room after the break. Perhaps Maha stood elsewhere when she took the photograph.
strings.suspects[1].name: Omar Nasef
strings.suspects[1].relation: Threatened to challenge Younes’s report over a financial dispute.
strings.suspects[1].alibi: In the service yard with the supplier from 20:02 to 20:11.
strings.suspects[1].statement: I entered the map room in muddy boots that afternoon. I objected to the report, but was checking a delivery during the incident; the supplier and footage can verify that.
strings.suspects[2].name: Salma Rashed
strings.suspects[2].alibi: Initially claimed a coffee break, then admitted being in the copy room from 20:04 to 20:10.
strings.suspects[2].statement: I hid the copying because I feared discipline. I was with Noha throughout; that room has no back door. My remark about silencing Younes concerned a written response over authorship, not violence.
strings.suspects[3].name: Hadi Ghoneim
strings.suspects[3].relation: Cropped crack photographs to support a misleading commercial account.
strings.suspects[3].alibi: In the maintenance hall from 20:02 to 20:12 except a salon visit at 20:03–20:04.
strings.suspects[3].statement: I supplied selective photographs; that was wrong. My salon clip ends at 20:04 and does not establish anyone’s presence after I left. I returned to filming before 20:05.
strings.witnesses[0].name: Maha Galal
strings.witnesses[0].statement: I know Rana and saw her face, waving at 20:08 as I cleaned the kiosk glass at the white mark. I called it the salon because I remembered the old layout. My sighting lasted less than a minute; I did not watch her throughout the break.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Yahya Magdi
strings.witnesses[1].statement: Younes signed in front of me at 20:06 for a transaction created at 20:05 and discussed its new details. I left at 20:06:30, reached the security desk at 20:07 and stayed with my colleague until the alarm.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Noha Tareq
strings.witnesses[2].statement: Salma was with me from 20:04 to 20:10, exchanging papers and taking a joint call. The entrance camera is continuous and the room has no other exit.
strings.folders[0].name: Sightline plan
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: 32-D1 — Sightline plan
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: North is up: map room M, then the projecting buttress, then salon Z to the south. From the fixed white kiosk mark, window M is visible and the buttress completely blocks Z. A daylight test established geometry, not night-time illumination. The radiator and patch in E1 and E4 independently identify the room.
strings.folders[1].name: Movement and access record
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: 32-D2 — Movement and access record
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: The indoor walk between M and Z takes less than 30 seconds. There is no extra external exit. Yahya and his colleague remained at security from 20:07 to the alarm; Nawal stayed at reception until going to the room at 20:10. Everyone present is accounted for, with no unknown entrant.
strings.folders[2].name: Nawal’s discovery report
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: 32-D3 — Nawal’s discovery report
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: Nawal entered the map room at 20:10, found Younes and called emergency services. Rana appeared in the hall after the shout. That later appearance does not establish her earlier location.
strings.folders[3].name: The witness’s position
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: 32-D4 — The witness’s position
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: Rana suggests Maha moved. Continuous kiosk-phone footage from 20:07:40 to 20:08:20 places Maha at the same white mark. Her use of “salon” came from an old remembered layout, not a sign read in the image.
strings.folders[4].name: Salma’s complete message context
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: 32-D5 — Salma’s complete message context
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: Full context: I will silence him with a documented response about my work credit; I will take a copy to the committee and will not confront him alone. Unauthorised copying is separate misconduct. A cropped phrase does not turn it into murder evidence; Noha and footage cover her presence.
strings.reports[0].title: 32-R1 — Medical findings and their limits
strings.reports[0].author: Investigation and examination team
strings.reports[0].body: Death resulted from a direct blunt assault, not a fall. The 20:06:30–20:10 interval comes from the last live interaction and discovery, not second-precise medical dating. The examination alone does not identify the assailant.
strings.reports[1].title: 32-R2 — Image and clock examination
strings.reports[1].author: Investigation and examination team
strings.reports[1].body: The clips and photograph are original, full-frame and unmirrored, with agreeing clocks. Rana’s identity in the 20:08 image is undisputed. The comparison concerns the window and its features, not the witness’s ability to recognise her face.
